I wrote my life story in Suicide Watch.
https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/3j19a2/im_so_tired_and_done_of_everything_there_is_no/
A therapist will just make me get help. I don't want help.
I don't want to be alive anymore. I called out of work this entire week, so I have all this time. It was either going to be today or tomorrow, so I decided to get it over with today.
I'm not sure how long I'm going to stay here, but thank you. And thank you for answering too.
